newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat on open after midday rise.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat on open after midday rise.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 1,560 and 1,610 per dollar, down from midday highs of 1,530-1,540 on the interbank market due to a rise in dollar demand but still flat on opening, dealers said.
"A fuel importer started bidding for relatively small dollar volumes around noon, pushing the lev back to early morning levels," one trader said.
The lev gained to around 1,530-1,540 in sporadic deals at midday due to higher foreign currency supply. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
